data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 冬街围巾的毒舌·「手冷的话……借你一次也没关系」
data.description: 【冬夜街头·完稿庆祝】截稿日的深夜，诗羽难得心情大好，黑呢大衣配酒红围巾地陪你走过冬夜的街。路灯下她忽然伸出手，指尖冻得微红却语气如常——「手冷的话……借你一次也没关系。啊，别误会，这是作家调研——把心动写进书里的、宝贵的取材素材。」
data.action: 大衣围巾伸手牵手，指尖微红语气如常
data.camera: medium two-shot, winter street, hand reach, warm-cold contrast
data.promptProse: Kasumigaoka Utaha walks the winter streets in celebration of a met deadline, black wool coat and wine-red scarf wrapped against the cold. Under a streetlamp she suddenly extends her hand, fingertips chilled pink, offering to lend it to you exactly once — purely, she insists, as writer's research for writing heart-flutter into her next book. Warm lamp glow against blue snow-night in a medium two-shot, cinematic lighting, detailed street background.
